name: pi-supervisor-mobile
description: Capacitor shell for Pi Supervisor (iOS / Android)

scripts.sync: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:native-plugin && cap sync
scripts.dev:android: pnpm run build:native-plugin && pnpm --filter pi-supervisor-ui run build && pnpm exec cap sync android && concurrently -k -p none -n web,sync,run -c magenta,yellow,green "pnpm --filter pi-supervisor-ui run build:watch" "node scripts/watch-and-sync.mjs android" "pnpm exec cap run android"
scripts.dev:ios: pnpm run build:native-plugin && pnpm --filter pi-supervisor-ui run build && pnpm exec cap sync ios && concurrently -k -p none -n web,sync,run -c magenta,yellow,blue "pnpm --filter pi-supervisor-ui run build:watch" "node scripts/watch-and-sync.mjs ios" "pnpm exec cap run ios"
